note: Planned assertions only; no Ferric tests were run while preparing this pack.

tests.title: Pinned baseline and architecture inventory
tests.assertion: Record actual HEAD, dirty files, supported tools, baseline failures and existing identity/provenance/resource APIs. No production changes.

tests.title: Open shadow roots: discovery through final action
tests.assertion: An open-root button activates once and input focus settles on the retained input; demonstrate baseline failure or record non-reproduction.

tests.title: Nested slots and composed ancestry
tests.assertion: Slotted/open-root descendants share clipping and hit rules; inert/disabled ancestors and malformed/deep ancestry reject safely.

tests.title: Same-origin frame projection and replacement
tests.assertion: Nested frame borders, scroll offsets and clipping are respected; a reused frame path with a new document invalidates the old target.

tests.title: Hidden, detached and newly covered controls
tests.assertion: Hidden, opacity-zero ordinary, disabled, inert, detached, adopted or covered targets do not activate; replacement with same text does not inherit selection.

tests.title: Viewport overflow regression preservation
tests.assertion: Existing YouTube body/root zero-height, containment and partial clipping regressions still pass; no site-specific branch.

tests.title: Same-URL sibling is not final authority
tests.assertion: Discovery deduplication cannot authorise pointer delivery to a covering same-URL sibling. Semantic action retains the exact selected object.

tests.title: Actual focus rather than optimistic success
tests.assertion: Final focus checks the intended deep active element; a handler moving focus or refusing focus does not produce false focus-success.

tests.title: Typed candidate payload and safe labels
tests.assertion: Reject malformed IDs/geometry/extra authority fields; no control value, password, secret hidden buffer or HTML executes/leaks through labels.

tests.title: Local pointer/scoped entry provenance
tests.assertion: Local physical UI handoff works; IPC, CLI, aliases wrapping remote calls, macro/repeat/userscript/generic action-executor paths cannot mint or replay permits.

tests.title: Pointer-only custom control
tests.assertion: Explicit pointer action produces the qualified move/down/up/click sequence once; default semantic click is unchanged; no fallback double activation.

tests.title: Native activation regression types
tests.assertion: Links/target blank, regular buttons, inputs, contenteditable, open roots and same-origin frames retain default actions; explicit pointer never also runs URL or DOM transport.

tests.title: Pointer preflight races and expiry
tests.assertion: Reject observed owner/config/surface/overlay changes and expired preflights; stress the unobservable interval and document residual uncertainty, never claim atomicity.

tests.title: Engine activation restrictions
tests.assertion: Observe isTrusted and allowed/denied fullscreen/popup/clipboard/chooser outcomes without altering engine permission policy; no general trust claim.

tests.title: ACE-like paired EditorFocus
tests.assertion: Opt-in validated visible editor/unique receiver pair focuses the exact eligible invisible proxy; false class-only and ambiguous signatures reject.

tests.title: Bootstrap-like LabelControl
tests.assertion: Exact visible label/control association toggles an enabled checkbox/radio once; it is not an editor proxy; disabled/inert/control replacement rejects.

tests.title: Proxy exclusion and identity
tests.assertion: No password/file/type-hidden/read-only/disabled/inert/display-none receiver; representative/receiver swap or cross-document pair rejects; selectors cannot grant exception.

tests.title: Editor native entry modes and composition
tests.assertion: i/I, Enter/Shift+Enter, Escape, lost releases and supported IMEs preserve typing; live framework qualification reports exact library version separately.

tests.title: Script extraction parity and isolation
tests.assertion: Manifest/hash/package parity, legacy facade behaviour, ApplicationWorld isolation, resource missing/version mismatch and exception failure paths all pass.

tests.title: Operation/map lifetime and handoff
tests.assertion: No hint-map destruction before callback; acquire destination lease before source cleanup; weak refs, observers and callbacks terminate exactly once.

tests.title: Mixed key parser and effective policy
tests.assertion: Reject multi-key/modifier-only/duplicate/reserved entries and more than 64; preserve existing token conventions; exact replace/inherit precedence and atomic errors.

tests.title: Early QML-special key ownership
tests.assertion: Configured /, ?, f and Ctrl+f reach page once; : and recovery controls remain browser-owned; unconfigured sites retain baseline.

tests.title: Count/keychain semantics
tests.assertion: Mapped first g/digit can go to page; active browser chain/count retains continuations; misses/timeouts/config changes never replay buffered tokens to page.

tests.title: Physical gesture regression
tests.assertion: Native keydown/up, repeats, overlaps, entry-key isolation, lost releases, delayed WebEngine copies and epoch changes never double-dispatch or become a new browser command.

tests.title: Escape, mode labels and primary/secondary parity
tests.assertion: Existing Ctrl+v/Ctrl+Shift+v/;v/i/I and recovery/emergency semantics plus both window status/help surfaces remain correct.

tests.title: SPA identity and real navigation
tests.assertion: Positive same-document proof preserves only user-entered persistent mode; new document/reload/death exits; one-shot cancels route changes; uncertainty keeps safe baseline.

tests.title: Configuration/focus change during held input
tests.assertion: New gesture gets new effective route/config; an existing gesture keeps its routing owner; no manual redirect to an old or newly active DOM recipient.

tests.title: Native prompt leases and nesting
tests.assertion: Keyboard-only chooser accept/cancel and supported nested prompts restore only the matching suspended epoch/owner; native input is not stolen by Mixed policy.

tests.title: Prompt stale completion and one-shot cancellation
tests.assertion: Tab/document/config/manual-mode change invalidates restoration; out-of-order completions fail safely; never resurrect Hint/Grid/Pass Next Key.

tests.title: Selector prepare/validate/commit
tests.assertion: Malformed CSS, unavailable engine, startup, stale validation callback and rejected persistence before replacement leave the full old effective config intact; no regex-only success. Replacement followed by failed directory sync publishes aligned memory and reports committed durability-uncertain.

tests.title: Selector layering and disabled families
tests.assertion: Global/profile/site extend/replace, empty replace, 16/32-selector and byte limits, rule order and default all independence match C09.

tests.title: Custom selector fresh/final policy
tests.assertion: Added custom target remains eligible through fresh/final action using captured policy; removed policy cancels; invalid kinds never gain URL/proxy/native capability.

tests.title: Selector/traversal resource stress
tests.assertion: Large/dynamic roots and expensive selectors expose bounded/truncated status; caps do not pretend synchronous CSS evaluation can be interrupted.

tests.title: Region and surface classification
tests.assertion: Named/structural regions and visible surfaces are capped/deduplicated; generic div/hidden canvas floods are not candidates; default f unchanged.

tests.title: Cross-origin/closed-root boundaries
tests.assertion: Only outer iframe/surface is inspectable by parent; semantic within rejects; explicit raw native Grid is separately qualified; no false child semantic support.

tests.title: Scoped registry lease transfer
tests.assertion: Source session retains records until destination weak scope lease validates; cancellation/replacement clears without leaks; one page-target session per window.

tests.title: Scoped hints and scroll independence
tests.assertion: Descendants only, no empty-scope full-page fallback; hint/search actions do not change focus/scroll; explicit Set scroll target uses existing axis/invalidation semantics.

tests.title: Scoped Grid coordinate spaces
tests.assertion: Nonzero scope, nested borders, zoom, DPR and window offsets map exactly once into ViewLocal coordinates; reject unsupported transforms instead of guessing.

tests.title: Grid scope lifecycle and hover
tests.assertion: 0/Backspace/Space reset within scope; reflow/owner/config changes invalidate; ordinary repaint does not cancel; full-view Grid regression remains.

tests.title: Target Search existing matcher reuse
tests.assertion: Same candidate/query ranking as existing Hint text mode, visible-only labels, explicit confirmation, correct defaults and no durable switcher cache.

tests.title: Virtualised target meaning and selection
tests.assertion: Removed/recycled row or changed action meaning clears selection; index or same label never silently selects another record; offscreen content not claimed searchable.

tests.title: Diagnostic privacy and provenance
tests.assertion: Only on-demand bounded rule/error/focus facts; no raw key logging, input values, tokenised URLs or page-label persistence; private export requires consent.

tests.title: Comparable performance samples
tests.assertion: 10 warm-ups and 100 measured samples; 500 at three zoom levels plus 1000/5000; stage timings and raw p95 calculation; specified common-case regression threshold.

tests.title: Teardown and weak-reference stress
tests.assertion: 1000 start/cancel cycles and forced GC leave no growing retained maps/listeners/observers; legitimate connected weak targets stay usable in qualified engine.

tests.title: Whole legacy interaction regression
tests.assertion: Existing hints/rapid/counts/caret/search/macros/Grid/scroll/Insert/pass-through tests remain; new capability restrictions do not delete legacy legitimate paths.

tests.title: Native double-click order
tests.assertion: One explicit native double-click path with expected engine sequence; no duplicate Ferric navigation or DOM fallback; uncertain dispatch never retries.

tests.title: Drag feasibility and teardown experiment
tests.assertion: Prove in-view press/move/release plus cancellation/capture/receiver-loss cleanup through public adapter; state the supported widget categories or no-go.

tests.title: Bounded pointer drag implementation
tests.assertion: Two points selected before press; 12-step/200ms path, 1000ms watchdog; sliders/pointer-driven canvas only where qualified; no file/cross-window/modifier drag.

tests.title: Drag cancellation can have site effects
tests.assertion: Release clears native button state or receiver-gone bookkeeping without events in replacement view; drop may commit and is disclosed; no retry/fictional rollback.

tests.title: Framework adapter capability/conflict report
tests.assertion: Evaluate each named framework/version and supported public API; focus independent of extract/apply; writeback conflict, undo, permission and no-partial-mutation proof or no-go.

tests.title: Public accessibility-provider capability
tests.assertion: Prove public names/roles/bounds/actions and screen-reader coexistence or no-go; no semantic canvas/closed-root claim based on API existence alone.

tests.title: Independent child-frame capability
tests.assertion: Compile/runtime Qt gates, isolated per-frame collection, geometry/identity/destruction/return-data bounds are proved or recorded unavailable; no parent DOM bypass.

tests.title: Alternative hint ergonomics evaluation
tests.assertion: Compare stable defaults and text search to numeric/scattered/word prototype with gestures/time/errors/churn; no default change or human-study claim from automation.

tests.title: Wheel-only task evaluation
tests.assertion: Identify a real task not solved by explicit scrolling/page keys; either no-go/no need, or future bounded ADR requirements; no new wheel implementation authorised.

tests.title: Registry/CLI/IPC/resource documentation parity
tests.assertion: New arguments/settings/help and invalid combinations agree across registry/codecs/runtime; local-only paths reject remotely; manifests/hashes/docs regenerate cleanly.

tests.title: Installed-release live task qualification
tests.assertion: Disposable authorised Docs/Sheets/Slides, mail/chat, advanced editor, GitHub/Reddit, YouTube, board/canvas/frame tasks record platform and real outcome, not inferred support.

tests.title: Fresh integrated release gates
tests.assertion: Rerun applicable full gates on integrated HEAD and report baseline failures, unsupported research and unrun native cases without claiming universal readiness.
